Actress Ananya Raj Dies at 27 After Health Battle

Actress Ananya Raj has died at the age of 27. Her family confirmed her death, stating she had been battling health issues. The All India Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has mourned her passing. Raj was known for her roles in projects including 'Ghost' and '7 Hours To Go'. Some reports indicate her family shared information about her death a month after the event.
